core_obligations: Read off the complex and the augmentation: for X a ringed space with covering U : X = bigcup_{i in I} U_i and an O_X-module F, the terms C^p(U,F) = prod_{i_0...i_p} (j_{i_0...i_p})_* F_{i_0...i_p}, where F_{i_0...i_p} is the restriction of F to U_{i_0...i_p}, together with the differential of equation-d-cech make C^bullet(U,F) a complex of O_X-modules carrying a canonical map F -> C^bullet(U,F) (statement lines 4573-4594).
Reduce the quasi-isomorphism to a stalkwise exactness statement: it suffices to show that 0 -> F_x -> C^0(U,F)_x -> C^1(U,F)_x -> ... is exact for every x in X (proof lines 4597-4603).

Construct the contracting homotopy: fix i_fix in I with x in U_{i_fix}; for s in C^p(U,F)_x choose a representative s~ over a neighbourhood V of x and define h(s)_{i_0...i_{p-1}} = s~_{i_fix i_0 ... i_{p-1}, x}, the same formula in degree 0 giving C^0(U,F)_x -> F_x (proof lines 4604-4623).

Verify the homotopy identity: expand (dh + hd)(s)_{i_0...i_p} to obtain sum_j (-1)^j s_{i_fix i_0 ... hat{i}_j ... i_p} + s_{i_0...i_p} + sum_j (-1)^{j+1} s_{i_fix i_0 ... hat{i}_j ... i_p}, observe that the two signed sums cancel, and conclude (dh + hd)(s) = s, so that h is a homotopy from the identity of the extended complex to zero and C^bullet(U,F) is a resolution of F (proof lines 4624-4652).
proof_roadmap: Check exactness of the extended complex 0 -> F -> C^0(U,F) -> C^1(U,F) -> ... at an arbitrary stalk (proof lines 4597-4603).
Choose i_fix with x in U_{i_fix} and define h by inserting i_fix in the first slot of a representative cochain (proof lines 4604-4623).
Expand (dh + hd)(s) and cancel the two signed sums to obtain hd + dh = id, then conclude (proof lines 4624-4652).
difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits a resolution of an arbitrary O_X-module F by the product-of-pushforwards complex C^p(U,F) = prod_{i_0...i_p} (j_{i_0...i_p})_* F_{i_0...i_p} attached to an open covering U : X = bigcup_{i in I} U_i, with the Cech differential of equation-d-cech (statement lines 4573-4594). The proof does not chase the Cech complex globally: it reduces the quasi-isomorphism to exactness at every stalk and then writes down an explicit contracting homotopy h which inserts a fixed index i_fix in front of a cochain, the same formula in degree 0 supplying the augmentation C^0(U,F)_x -> F_x (proof lines 4604-4623). The verification is the displayed three-line computation of (dh + hd)(s)_{i_0...i_p}, in which the reindexed boundary terms occur twice with opposite signs and cancel, leaving s_{i_0...i_p}, so that h is a homotopy from the identity of the extended complex to zero (proof lines 4624-4652). What has to be supplied by hand is exactly this homotopy together with the observation that the doubly indexed section is defined over U_{i_0...i_p}; nothing beyond the Cech differential is imported. The claim is H2.
